title.value: NL-PS-L4-B - Level 4b: Two maximal GBBs per section

description.value: The serving system provides an NL-PS for its level 4b test patient, in which all metadata is present, every mandatory section except Medication summary has at least two entries, each with a maximal generic building block (GBB) and a generated narrative, and Medication summary has no entries, and has an emptyReason and a narrative. Conformancelab sends the bearer token you enter at test setup to your server. Use a token issued by your own system that gives access to your level 4b test patient, and only to that patient. Without a token the server may return the Patient Summaries of several patients; the script then tests the first one. Implementation Guides: NL-PS https://ig.nictiz.nl/nlps/ and generic building blocks (GBB) https://ig.nictiz.nl/gbb/

nts:include.check: every section has a readable narrative summary that matches its entries, and the Medication summary section has a readable narrative that explains why the section is empty. The entries are complete and fit the Dutch context.
